records.title: Certyfikat z usługi Campaign Manager 360 (2026 r.)
records.description: Certyfikaty z usług Google Marketing Platform potwierdzają kwalifikacje użytkowników, którzy wykazali się umiejętnością realizacji najważniejszych zadań i procesów w tych usługach. Egzaminy certyfikacyjne są przeznaczone dla użytkowników z praktycznym doświadczeniem w korzystaniu z usług Google Marketing Platform i sprawdzają konkretne kryteria związane z kluczowymi zadaniami. Użytkownikom, którzy nie mają bezpośredniego doświadczenia z tymi usługami, odradzamy przystępowanie do egzaminów certyfikacyjnych. Informacje o egzaminie Certyfikat z usługi Campaign Manager 360 potwierdza umiejętność planowania, przeprowadzania i optymalizowania zaawansowanych kampanii cyfrowych. Egzamin obejmuje techniczną hierarchię struktur konta i miejsc docelowych, wdrażanie śledzenia własnego za pomocą tagu Google oraz wdrażanie zaawansowanych przepływów pracy dotyczących reklam wideo (VAST/VPAID). Oprócz podstawowych umiejętności związanych z traffikingiem użytkownicy muszą wykazać się umiejętnością rozwiązywania problemów z konfliktami wyświetlania, konfigurowania integracji z Display & Video 360 oraz wykorzystywania Menedżera danych do dostarczania danych o konwersjach offline. Egzamin sprawdza wiedzę związaną zwykle z tymi rolami: – trafikerzy i specjaliści ds. operacji reklamowych, – analitycy, – media plannerzy. Będziesz mieć 75 minut, aby odpowiedzieć na 50 pytań jednokrotnego wyboru.

Giải thích tầm quan trọng của việc áp dụng tư duy linh hoạt và sử dụng ngân sách linh hoạt để đáp ứng nhu cầu và thúc đẩy kết quả kinh doanh thực tế. Sử dụng tính năng báo cáo và thông tin chi tiết của Google Ads để hiểu rõ hơn về AI của Google. records.title: Search Ads 360 Certification Exam
records.description: Google Marketing Platform Product Certifications identify qualified users who demonstrate the ability to perform critical tasks and workflows with Platform products. The certification exams are designed for users with real-world, hands-on experience using Google Marketing Platform products, and test on specific predetermined criteria aligned with critical job tasks. The certification exams are not recommended for users who don’t have direct product experience. About this exam The Search Ads 360 Certification exam covers setting up Search campaigns across multiple search engines: assigning goals, targeting and bid strategies; troubleshooting issues; measuring the impact and optimising campaigns for improved performance. This exam tests knowledge across a broad range of topics related to automation, attribution, reporting and conversion measurement. Users completing this exam should have an understanding of the paid search industry and how Search Ads 360 can be leveraged to manage campaigns from one interface. The knowledge tested in this exam typically aligns with the following roles: Paid Search Director Paid Search Manager Paid Search Supervisor Paid Search Analyst You will have 75 minutes to complete 50 multiple choice questions.

records.title: Introduction to building AI agents
records.description: Curious about building AI agents but not sure where to start? Introduction to building AI agents is a practical introduction to how AI agents work, what tools and services Microsoft offers for building them, and how to plan an agent solution before you start building. You'll explore what agents are and the business value they unlock, tour Microsoft's agent platform — including Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and the Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit — and learn how to choose the right development approach, channels, grounding services, integrations, and governance posture for your scenario. After completing this course, you'll be prepared to translate a business problem into a complete agent design and development plan. Audience Profile Introduction to building AI agents is designed for builders and developers who want to build AI agents on Microsoft's agent platform. It's ideal for learners who are new to agent development or evaluating Microsoft's options, and who want to understand how to choose the right tools, ground and connect agents to their data and systems, and plan an agent solution end to end. Learners come from both low-code and pro-code backgrounds; no prior agent development experience is required.

records.title: Exame de certificação do Campaign Manager 360
records.description: As certificações de produtos do Google Marketing Platform identificam usuários qualificados que conseguem realizar tarefas e fluxos de trabalho importantes com os produtos do GMP. Os exames de certificação são feitos para usuários que têm experiência prática com os produtos do Google Marketing Platform. Além disso, eles avaliam critérios específicos predeterminados, associados a tarefas importantes. Os exames de certificação não são recomendados para usuários sem experiência direta com o produto. Sobre o exame O exame de certificação do Campaign Manager aborda o planejamento, a implementação, a geração de relatórios e a solução de problemas de compras por reserva ao trabalhar com parceiros. Ele também avalia seu conhecimento sobre a exibição de tags de anúncio, as formas de medição e os métodos de solução de problemas usados para otimizar o desempenho. Os usuários que quiserem fazer o exame devem ter experiência com o Campaign Manager. O exame aborda todo o uso do produto, desde a programação até a geração de relatórios. No entanto, ele normalmente não se aplica a algumas funções especializadas, como planejadores de agências, por testar conhecimentos abrangentes. O conhecimento avaliado nesse exame está associado às seguintes funções: Coordenador de publicidade Analista Você vai ter 75 minutos para responder a 50 perguntas de múltipla escolha.

records.title: Les synergies entre la Réduction des Risques de Catastrophe et l´Action Climatique Parcours d'apprentissage
records.description: *Cours bientôt disponible* Ce parcours d’apprentissage actualisé et enrichi, développé en partenariat avec le Bureau des Nations Unies pour la réduction des risques de catastrophe (UNDRR), s’appuie sur le succès de la version initiale du cours et répond à une demande croissante d’orientations pratiques pour renforcer les synergies entre la réduction des risques de catastrophe (RRC) et l’action climatique. Le parcours d’apprentissage est structuré en deux modules complémentaires. Le premier module présente les concepts fondamentaux, les cadres de référence et les approches permettant de promouvoir la cohérence entre la RRC et l’ACC à travers l’approche de Gestion des Risques Climatiques (Climate Risk Management – CRM). Le second module propose une analyse approfondie d’applications concrètes, à travers des études de cas et des bonnes pratiques issues de différentes régions et de différents niveaux de gouvernance où l’intégration de la RRC et de l’action climatique a été mise en œuvre avec succès. Grâce à cette combinaison de connaissances fondamentales et d’exemples pratiques, les participants acquerront une compréhension globale de la manière dont les synergies entre la RRC et l’action climatique peuvent renforcer la résilience, optimiser l’utilisation des ressources et soutenir des stratégies cohérentes de gestion des risques.
records.eligibility: Everyone; Ce parcours d’apprentissage s’adresse aux décideurs et aux praticiens, notamment aux points focaux chargés de la réduction des risques de catastrophe et de l’adaptation aux changements climatiques, qui participent directement à l’élaboration et à la mise en œuvre de stratégies nationales de réduction des risques de catastrophe, de plans nationaux d’adaptation et de politiques connexes aux niveaux local, infranational, national, régional et international. Le parcours est également pertinent pour les fonctionnaires, les professionnels du développement, les responsables de l’élaboration des politiques publiques, les chercheurs et les autres parties prenantes souhaitant promouvoir les synergies entre la réduction des risques de catastrophe et l’action climatique, ainsi que renforcer des approches plus cohérentes de gestion des risques climatiques et de catastrophe.

Bài kiểm tra cấp giấy chứng nhận này dành cho những người dùng đã sử dụng sản phẩm trong thực tế. Giới thiệu về bài kiểm tra này Giấy chứng nhận này thể hiện sự thành thạo của bạn trong việc thúc đẩy sự tăng trưởng thông qua trải nghiệm trên thiết bị di động. Bài kiểm tra sẽ đánh giá kiến thức về nhiều chủ đề liên quan đến trải nghiệm của người dùng trên thiết bị di động. Những người dùng hoàn thành bài kiểm tra này cần hiểu rõ thiết bị di động là một kênh thu nạp khách hàng cũng như hiểu rõ vai trò của thiết bị di động trong hành vi trực tuyến. Khi đạt giấy chứng nhận của Google Ads về khả năng thúc đẩy sự tăng trưởng thông qua thiết bị di động, Google công nhận bạn có những khả năng sau đây: Đánh giá tác động của trải nghiệm người dùng sau khi họ nhấn vào quảng cáo Cộng tác với các đối tác quan trọng để xây dựng một tổ chức tập trung hơn vào người dùng Mô tả các thành phần cốt lõi và giá trị của phương pháp tối ưu hóa tỷ lệ chuyển đổi Giải thích vai trò của các nhà tiếp thị trong việc mang lại trải nghiệm nhanh chóng trên thiết bị di động Giải thích vai trò của các nhà tiếp thị trong việc tạo ra trải nghiệm mượt mà cho người dùng Triển khai các phương pháp hay nhất để tăng tính cá nhân hóa trong trải nghiệm của người dùng trên thiết bị di động Lưu ý: Một số khóa học có thể chứa các đường liên kết đến các trang web không hỗ trợ tiếng Việt hoặc trang web sẽ yêu cầu bạn lựa chọn ngôn ngữ.

records.title: Manage and secure Microsoft 365 endpoints by using Intune
records.description: In this course, students learn to plan and execute an endpoint deployment, configuration, and management strategy using Microsoft Intune as the unified endpoint management platform. The course covers preparing identity and device infrastructure with Microsoft Entra ID, enrolling and configuring devices, managing applications, and protecting endpoints and data. Students also explore automation with PowerShell and Microsoft Graph, AI-assisted management with Microsoft Security Copilot, the extended capabilities of the Microsoft Intune Suite, and the delivery of cloud-hosted desktops with Windows 365 and Azure Virtual Desktop. Technologies explored include Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Entra ID, Windows Autopilot, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Tunnel, Microsoft Cloud PKI, the Microsoft Intune Suite, Windows 365, and Azure Virtual Desktop. Audience Profile As a candidate for this course and the associated exam, you have subject matter expertise managing devices and client applications in a Microsoft 365 tenant by using Microsoft Intune. As an endpoint administrator, you collaborate with architects, Microsoft 365 administrators, security administrators, and other workload administrators to plan and implement a modern workplace strategy that meets the business needs of an organization. You are responsible for: Implementing solutions for efficient deployment and management of endpoints on various operating systems, platforms, and device types. Implementing and managing endpoints at scale by using Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Intune Suite, Windows Autopilot, Microsoft Security Copilot, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Virtual Desktop, and Windows 365. Implementing identity, security, access, policies, updates, and apps for endpoints.

records.title: Plan, configure, and manage collaboration communications systems with Microsoft Teams
records.description: MS-721T00: Plan, configure, and manage collaboration communications systems with Microsoft Teams prepares IT professionals to become Collaboration Communications Systems Engineers. Participants will learn how to plan, configure, deploy, manage, and troubleshoot Microsoft Teams-based collaboration systems, including Teams Phone, Microsoft Teams Rooms, Teams Premium, and other certified devices. Learners will engage in hands-on labs and real-world scenarios that emphasize secure collaboration practices like least privilege access, identity protection, conditional access, and threat monitoring using Microsoft Defender and Teams admin tools. By the end of the course, learners will be able to: Design and implement Teams Phone with PSTN connectivity (Calling Plans, Operator Connect, Direct Routing) Manage Teams meetings, webinars, and town halls Configure Microsoft Teams Rooms and Surface Hub devices Monitor and optimize performance using Teams admin tools, PowerShell, and the Call Quality Dashboard Apply identity and access management best practices Audience Profile Collaboration Communications Systems Engineers are responsible for planning, deploying, configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting collaboration communication systems that include Microsoft Teams Phone, Microsoft Teams meetings, Microsoft Teams Premium, Microsoft Teams Rooms, flexible workspaces, and other certified and supported devices. They have a fundamental understanding of networking, telecommunications, audio/visual and meeting room technologies, and identity and access management. They're also proficient in managing collaboration and communications solutions by using Microsoft Teams admin center, Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro Management portal, PowerShell, and Microsoft Call Quality Dashboard. To succeed in their role, they collaborate with Teams administrators, Microsoft identity and access administrators, Microsoft 365 administrators, and owners of other workloads, including facilities managers, network engineers, security engineers, device manufacturers, telephony providers, and Microsoft Certified solution providers.

records.prerequisites: The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) is proud to offer the Incident Response Training event, Preventing DNS Infrastructure Tampering Cyber Range Training (IR206). The 200-level training events are open to government employees and contractors across federal, state, local, tribal, and territorial government, educational partners, and critical infrastructure partners . Please use your organization email address when registering. This course is ideal for those working in cybersecurity roles who are interested in learning technical incident response skills and requires active engagement from all participants. The course assumes a mixed audience (e.g., from disparate teams and organizations) of mixed capability. DNS is one of the core foundations of the internet however, it continues to be one of the mechanisms attackers use to perform malicious activities across the globe. In this course participants will learn about various concepts associated with DNS, become familiar with DNS tools and mapping information, get introduced to common DNS tampering techniques, and gain an understanding of DNS mitigation strategies to enhance security. Experience these benefits and more: Practice in a realistic environment : Analyze network and host-based artifacts and implement remediation changes for the identified vulnerabilities. Learn how to implement remediations: Course exercises include remediating vulnerabilities. Identify and mitigate vulnerabilities in real time: Students will identify DNS infrastructure tampering techniques and mitigate them. Expert facilitation and peer discussion: Throughout the course, expert cybersecurity engineers will moderate discussion and conduct a recovery debrief for the exercises. Participants are also encouraged to help one another and offer relevant input to address peers' questions. This exercise is a step-by-step, facilitated experience that uses a keyboard approach to understand these topics in a realistic technical environment. Approved registrants must attend a mandatory student technical check the day before the training to establish a connection to the course content and lab environment. EVENT

records.title: The Children and Armed Conflict Advanced Training (Third edition)
records.description: The application deadline is on 19 July 2026, 23:59 CEST Children are the primary victims of armed conflict and are disproportionally affected by it. Protecting them is a moral, legal and strategic imperative and failing to protect them risks undermining sustainable peace, stability and development. To better address the situation of conflict-affected children and prevent grave violations against them, partnerships with a broad range of actors are needed, as well as professionals who are trained on how to mainstream child rights and child protection in their respective fields of work. The Children and Armed Conflict (CAAC) Advanced Training aims to address those needs and develop skills and competencies that enable participants to translate knowledge into practice, thereby enhancing the protection of conflict-affected children. TO APPLY, PLEASE FILL OUT THIS APPLICATION FORM

In applying, the potential selected participants commit to actively participate in the training and to complete the above-mentioned CAAC Primer ahead of the first live session. records.title: Implement end‑to‑end security controls for cloud and AI workloads
records.description: This course prepares you to design, implement, and manage end-to-end security controls across Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 environments — including the emerging landscape of AI workloads and autonomous agents. Through a combination of instructor-led sessions and hands-on labs, you build practical skills in identity security, cloud infrastructure protection, threat detection, and posture management. This course is intended for security engineers who are responsible for planning and implementing security controls across cloud, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments using Microsoft security technologies. Audience Profile As a candidate for this course, you’re a security engineer who protects organizational systems and data across cloud and hybrid environments by implementing comprehensive security controls that prevent unauthorized access and mitigate risks proactively. This role spans multiple security domains including identity, network, application, data, and compute. This role also ensures that platforms, data, identities, and infrastructure used by AI workloads are securely implemented and monitored. You work closely with architects, administrators, engineers, analysts, and developers responsible for Azure, Microsoft 365, identity and access, information protection, security operations, devops, application development, database platforms, and networks. You should have practical experience in administration of Microsoft Azure and hybrid environments, including compute, network, and storage. You should have strong familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID and familiarity with Microsoft 365 administration. Your responsibilities for this role include: Securing access to resources by using Microsoft Entra ID and Azure Key Vault Enforcing security and regulatory compliance Securing storage, databases, and networking Securing compute Securing AI solutions Managing and monitoring security posture

Además de la coordinación básica de anuncios, se evalúa la capacidad de los usuarios para solucionar conflictos de publicación, integrarse con Display & Video 360 y aprovechar el Administrador de datos para transferir conversiones sin conexión. Perfiles ideales de los candidatos: --Coordinadores y operadores de anuncios --Analistas --Planificadores de medios Tendrás 75 minutos para completar 50 preguntas de opción múltiple.

records.title: Automate Administration with PowerShell
records.description: This course provides students with the fundamental knowledge and skills to use PowerShell for administering and automating administration of Windows servers. This course provides students the skills to identify and build the command they require to perform a specific task. In addition, students learn how to build scripts to accomplish advanced tasks such as automating repetitive tasks and generating reports. This course provides prerequisite skills supporting a broad range of Microsoft products, including Windows Server, Windows Client, Microsoft Azure, and Microsoft 365. In keeping with that goal, this course will not focus on any one of those products, although Windows Server, which is the common platform for all of those products, will serve as the example for the techniques this course teaches. Audience Profile This course is intended for IT Professionals who are already experienced in general Windows Server, Windows client, Azure, and Microsoft 365 administration, and who want to learn more about using Windows PowerShell for administration. No prior experience with any version of PowerShell or any scripting language is assumed. This course is also suitable for IT Professionals already experienced in server administration, including Microsoft Exchange Server, Microsoft SharePoint Server, and Microsoft SQL Server.

records.title: Search Ads 360-Zertifizierungsprüfung
records.description: Mit Zertifizierungen zu Google Marketing Platform-Produkten können Nutzer zeigen, dass sie in der Lage sind, wichtige Aufgaben und Workflows in Verbindung mit Platform-Produkten durchzuführen. Die Zertifizierungsprüfungen sind für Nutzer gedacht, die praktische Erfahrung mit Google Marketing Platform-Produkten haben. In den Prüfungen wird getestet, ob bei wichtigen Aufgaben bestimmte Kriterien erfüllt werden. Die Zertifizierungsprüfungen werden nicht für Nutzer empfohlen, die keine direkte Produkterfahrung haben. Informationen zu dieser Prüfung In der Zertifizierungsprüfung zu Search Ads 360 geht es um die Einrichtung von Suchnetzwerk-Kampagnen in mehreren Suchmaschinen. Darin eingeschlossen sind die Zuweisung von Zielvorhaben, Targeting und Gebotsstrategien, die Fehlerbehebung, die Auswertung der Ergebnisse sowie die Optimierung von Kampagnen für bessere Leistungen. In dieser Prüfung werden Kenntnisse zu vielen Themen getestet, die mit Automatisierung, Attribution, Berichterstellung und Conversion-Messung in Verbindung stehen. Nutzer, die diese Prüfung ablegen, sollten mit der bezahlten Suche vertraut sein und wissen, wie Kampagnen mithilfe von Search Ads 360 mit einer einzigen Benutzeroberfläche verwaltet werden können. Die in dieser Prüfung getesteten Kenntnisse sind für folgende Positionen relevant: Paid Search Director Paid Search Manager Paid Search Supervisor Paid Search Analyst Sie haben 75 Minuten Zeit, um 50 Multiple-Choice-Fragen zu beantworten.

records.title: Defend against cyberthreats with Microsoft's security operations platform
records.description: Learn how to investigate, respond to, and hunt for threats using Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender XDR and Microsoft Defender for Cloud. In this course you will learn how to mitigate cyberthreats using these technologies. Specifically, you will configure and use Microsoft Sentinel as well as utilize Kusto Query Language (KQL) to perform detection, analysis, and reporting. The course was designed for people who work in a Security Operations job role and helps learners prepare for the exam SC-200: Microsoft Security Operations Analyst. Audience Profile The Microsoft Security Operations Analyst collaborates with organizational stakeholders to secure information technology systems for the organization. Their goal is to reduce organizational risk by rapidly remediating active attacks in the environment, advising on improvements to threat protection practices, and referring violations of organizational policies to appropriate stakeholders. Responsibilities include threat management, monitoring, and response by using a variety of security solutions across their environment. The role primarily investigates, responds to, and hunts for threats using Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, and third-party security products. Since the Security Operations Analyst consumes the operational output of these tools, they are also a critical stakeholder in the configuration and deployment of these technologies.

records.title: Examen de certification Search Ads 360
records.description: Les certifications pour les produits Google Marketing Platform visent à identifier les utilisateurs qualifiés qui démontrent leur aptitude à exécuter des tâches critiques et des procédures avec les produits Platform. Les examens de certification s'adressent aux utilisateurs possédant une expérience pratique et concrète des produits Google Marketing Platform. Ils incluent des tests basés sur des critères prédéfinis précis en lien avec des responsabilités professionnelles critiques. Les examens de certification sont déconseillés aux personnes qui n'utilisent pas directement les produits. À propos de cet examen L'examen de certification Search Ads 360 porte sur la configuration de campagnes sur le Réseau de Recherche diffusées via de multiples moteurs de recherche, mais aussi sur l'attribution d'objectifs, de paramètres de ciblage et de stratégies d'enchères, et sur la résolution de problèmes. Il concerne également la mesure de l'impact et l'optimisation des campagnes à des fins d'amélioration des performances. Cet examen test les connaissances relatives à un large éventail de sujets concernant l'automatisation, l'attribution, la création de rapports et la mesure des conversions. Pour le passer, il est nécessaire de connaître le marché des liens commerciaux et de savoir utiliser Search Ads 360 pour gérer des campagnes via une interface. Les connaissances testées dans le cadre de cet examen sont en adéquation avec les rôles suivants : Directeur du service Liens commerciaux Responsable du service Liens commerciaux Chef du service Liens commerciaux Analyste du service Liens commerciaux Vous devrez répondre à 50 questions à choix multiples en 75 minutes.

records.description: YouTube 및 Google 동영상 광고 솔루션으로 성과를 도출하는 역량을 갖췄음을 보여주세요. 인증을 취득한 사용자는 YouTube와 Google 동영상 광고 솔루션을 사용하여 인지도, 구매 고려도, 액션 목표에 따라 성공적인 캠페인 결과를 이끌어 내는 방법을 이해하고 있음을 입증하게 됩니다. records.title: Developing in Agentic AI Systems
records.description: This course is designed to build practical skills in developing, deploying, and managing agentic AI systems within GitHub-based software development workflows. The course explores how to integrate AI agents into the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including designing agent architectures, configuring tools and environments, and managing agent memory, state, and execution. Students will learn how to evaluate and optimize agent performance, implement governance and guardrails, and coordinate multi-agent systems to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient outcomes. Through hands-on learning, participants will gain the skills needed to operate, supervise, and govern AI agents in production environments using GitHub as the control plane. Audience Profile Learners should have subject matter expertise in operating, integrating, supervising, and governing AI agents inside production-grade SDLC workflows and development environments, ensuring reliability, safety, and velocity using GitHub as the system of record and control plane. Learners work closely with architects, platform engineers, DevOps engineers, application developers, product managers, and security engineers to develop, deploy, operate, and manage agents that operate within the GitHub platform. Learners should have experience with the software development lifecycle (SDLC), workflows in GitHub and controls, and code quality, security, and review practices. You should also have experience with coding agents including GitHub Copilot, MCP servers and agent customization such as custom instructions, custom agents, tools, and Copilot setup Responsibilities for this role include: Operating agent workflows inside the SDLC Supervising autonomous behavior with GitHub controls Evaluating and tuning agent outputs using scans and artifacts Configuring custom agents Coordinating multi-agent execution safely

records.title: Сертификационный экзамен по оптимизации конверсий
records.description: Сертификационные экзамены по Google Платформе для маркетинга позволяют проверить, насколько успешно тот или иной пользователь справляется с основными задачами и рабочими процессами в продуктах Google Платформы для маркетинга. Экзамены рассчитаны на пользователей с практическим опытом работы. Знания оцениваются на основе определенных критериев, связанных с решением ключевых рабочих задач. Какие знания проверяются на сертификационном экзамене по мобильным ресурсам Этот экзамен позволят оценить, насколько вы умеете развивать бизнес с помощью мобильных ресурсов. Экзамен охватывает самые разные темы, связанные с оптимизацией мобильных сайтов и приложений. Чтобы сдать его, вы должны знать, как эти ресурсы помогают расширять клиентскую базу и какую роль они играют в поведении покупателей в онлайн-среде. Если вы успешно сдадите экзамен, то получите сертификат Google Рекламы по развитию бизнеса с помощью мобильных ресурсов. Он подтверждает, что вы можете: оценить влияние удобства мобильных ресурсов на рост конверсий; организовать работу с ключевыми партнерами, чтобы создать компанию, ориентированную на интересы пользователей; объяснить, в чем заключается оптимизация коэффициента конверсии и для чего она нужна; рассказать о том, что делают маркетологи, чтобы обеспечить высокую скорость работы мобильных сайтов и приложений; объяснить, как работа маркетологов делает мобильные ресурсы более удобными; применить рекомендации о том, как персонализировать мобильные ресурсы. Примечание. В некоторых курсах содержатся ссылки на сайты, где может быть недоступен язык, указанный у вас в настройках, или где необходимо его выбрать.

records.title: Microsoft Cybersecurity Architect
records.description: This is an advanced, expert-level course . Although not required to attend, students are strongly encouraged to have taken and passed another associate level certification in the security, compliance and identity portfolio (such as AZ-500, SC-200 or SC-300) before attending this class. This course prepares students with the expertise to design and evaluate cybersecurity strategies in the following areas: Zero Trust, Governance Risk Compliance (GRC), security operations (SecOps), and data and applications. Students will also learn how to design and architect solutions using zero trust principles and specify security requirements for cloud infrastructure in different service models (SaaS, PaaS, IaaS). Audience Profile This course is for experienced cloud security engineers who have taken a previous certification in the security, compliance and identity portfolio. Specifically, students should have advanced experience and knowledge in a wide range of security engineering areas, including identity and access, platform protection, security operations, securing data, and securing applications. They should also have experience with hybrid and cloud implementations. Beginning students should instead take the course SC-900: Microsoft Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals.

records.title: Architecting agentic AI business solutions
records.description: Architecting agentic AI business solutions is an advanced course for architects, senior consultants, and technical leaders responsible for planning, designing, and governing AI-powered enterprise solutions built on Microsoft platforms. This course serves as a foundational, real-world, and architectural preparation step that builds the design judgment, strategic reasoning, and end-to-end understanding learners need before pursuing the AB‑100 exam or implementing agentic AI solutions at scale. Learners will explore how to architect AI-powered business solutions that use agents, copilots, and generative AI to automate tasks, improve decision-making, and enhance employee and customer experiences. Emphasis is placed on architecture, trade-offs, governance, cost/benefit analysis, and lifecycle management, rather than step-by-step configuration. Audience Profile This course is intended for experienced technology professionals who are responsible for planning, designing, and guiding AI-powered business solutions using Microsoft platforms. This course assumes familiarity with Microsoft business applications, cloud concepts, and solution architecture fundamentals. It is best suited for learners who want to deepen their architectural judgment, design decision-making, and enterprise readiness for agentic AI solutions—rather than those seeking step-by-step configuration guidance or exam preparation. Important Note : While this course aligns conceptually with many of the AB‑100 exam skill areas, it is not a test-preparation course and does not focus on test-taking strategies. Instead, it provides the architectural foundations, enterprise context, and design reasoning that make AB‑100 learning meaningful and applicable. For many learners, this course serves as a recommended preparatory step before beginning focused AB‑100 exam study. The ideal audience includes: Solution Architects and Enterprise Architects designing intelligent and agent-based business solutions Senior Functional and Technical Consultants working with Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, or Azure AI services AI and Digital Transformation Leads defining AI strategy, governance, and adoption across the organization Application Architects and Technical Leads integrating agents, copilots, and generative AI into enterprise workloads Experienced practitioners preparing to advance toward formal AI solution validation, seeking architectural depth rather than exam-focused instruction

records.description: Welcome to the Waze Map Editor Traffic Events and Road Closures Course As a Waze Map Editor, you play a vital role in keeping the map accurate and helping drivers navigate smoothly. But road closures can still disrupt their journeys. By mapping Traffic Events and road closures, you help Waze provide advanced and real-time updates and smarter routes. Traffic Events explain why an area is affected, like concerts, construction, or emergencies, while Road Closures define the specific segments that are closed. records.description: This course is your essential guide to mastering the best practices required to build a highly accurate and navigable Waze map. The core purpose of these advanced practices is to optimize the Falcon Snapper, the powerful mechanism that continuously compares driver GPS data to the map, ensuring Waze knows exactly which road segment every driver is on in real-time. By learning best practices for Road Splits & Doglegs, precise Road Width and Position mapping, proper use of At-Grade-Connectors (AGCs), and how to apply Angles Heuristics (Turn Instruction Overrides), you will minimize snapping ambiguity. A more accurate map leads to fewer incorrect reroutes and a vastly improved driving experience for the entire Waze community. Get ready to dive deep and enhance your contributions! records.title: Build intelligent applications
records.description: This course teaches learners how to design and build intelligent applications on the Microsoft Power Platform by using AI, copilots, and agents to solve real business problems. Learners explore how Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages, Copilot Studio, and AI‑enabled capabilities work together to create agent‑first, AI‑enhanced solutions that improve productivity, decision‑making, and user experience. Audience Profile This course is designed for individuals who want to learn how to build intelligent applications using the Microsoft Power Platform and are new to using AI, copilots, and agents in solution design. It is ideal for learners with a general understanding of business processes or app building who want to develop the skills to analyze requirements, select appropriate Power Platform components, and create AI‑enhanced solutions. The course introduces how AI and agents can improve application behavior, automation, and user experience, while also building awareness of governance and responsible use as learners begin their journey into intelligent app development.

records.provider: FEMA National Disaster & Emergency Management University (NDEMU)
records.title: Introduction to Community Emergency Response Team (CERTs)
records.description: This Independent Study (IS) course is an introduction to the Community Emergency Response Team (CERT) program for those interested in learning about the CERT program for their own knowledge or as a pre-requisite for completing the CERT Basic classroom training that may be available in your community. The course includes three lessons: Introduction to CERT; What CERTs Do; and, Becoming Involved. In Lesson 1, Introduction to CERT, you will learn what a CERT is, the origin of the national CERT program, examples of local CERT volunteer organizations, and the general and national purpose of CERT. Lesson 2: What CERTs Do, describes CERT roles and responsibilities, how CERTs work with formal emergency response organizations, how CERTs integrate into an Incident Command System (ICS) structure, and what CERTs do and do not do. The lesson describes various CERT volunteer organizations and offers examples of how CERT programs have been implemented around the country and for different communities. You will also learn about case study examples of how CERT programs are helping various communities. Lesson 3: Becoming Involved, discusses the required training to become a CERT volunteer, the benefits of being a CERT volunteer, and what you may be asked to do as part of a CERT. This lesson identifies ways in which you, as a CERT volunteer, can serve your community during emergencies and how the CERT organization can provide for your effective participation in disaster response. records.title: Implement a Lakehouse with Microsoft Fabric
records.description: This course is designed to build your foundational skills in data engineering on Microsoft Fabric, focusing on the Lakehouse concept. This course will explore the powerful capabilities of Apache Spark for distributed data processing and the essential techniques for efficient data management, versioning, and reliability by working with Delta Lake tables. This course will also explore data ingestion and orchestration using Dataflows Gen2 and Data Factory pipelines. This course includes a combination of lectures and hands-on exercises that will prepare you to work with Lakehouses in Microsoft Fabric. Audience Profile The primary audience for this course is data professionals who are familiar with data modeling, extraction, and analytics. It is designed for professionals who are interested in gaining knowledge about Lakehouse architecture, the Microsoft Fabric platform, and how to enable end-to-end analytics using these technologies.

records.title: Certificeringsexamen voor Search Ads 360
records.description: Met Google Marketing Platform-productcertificeringen worden gekwalificeerde gebruikers geïdentificeerd die bekwaamheid tonen bij de uitvoering van essentiële taken en workflows voor Platform-producten. De certificeringsexamens zijn ontworpen voor gebruikers met echte praktijkervaring met Google Marketing Platform-producten. In deze examens wordt getest op bepaalde vooraf vastgestelde criteria die overeenkomen met essentiële taken. De certificeringsexamens worden niet aangeraden voor gebruikers die geen directe productervaring hebben. Over dit examen In het certificeringsexamen voor Search Ads 360 wordt het volgende behandeld: configuratie van campagnes in het zoeknetwerk op meerdere zoekmachines; toewijzing van doelen, targeting en biedstrategieën; probleemoplossing; meting van de impact; en optimalisatie van campagnes voor verbeterde prestaties. In dit examen wordt de kennis getest over een breed scala aan onderwerpen met betrekking tot automatisering, toeschrijving, rapportage en het bijhouden van conversies. Gebruikers die dit examen afleggen, moeten inzicht hebben in de branche voor betaalde zoekresultaten en weten hoe Search Ads 360 kan worden gebruikt om campagnes via één interface te beheren. De kennis die in dit examen wordt getest, komt over het algemeen overeen met de volgende rollen: Directeur Betaalde zoekresultaten Manager Betaalde zoekresultaten Supervisor Betaalde zoekresultaten Analist Betaalde zoekresultaten U heeft 75 minuten om 50 meerkeuzevragen te beantwoorden.

records.title: Esame di certificazione su Search Ads 360
records.description: Le certificazioni sui prodotti Google Marketing Platform attestano le capacità di utenti qualificati che dimostrano di essere in grado di eseguire attività e flussi di lavoro critici con i prodotti della piattaforma. Gli esami di certificazione sono concepiti per gli utenti con un'esperienza pratica e concreta nell'utilizzo dei prodotti Google Marketing Platform e verificano criteri predeterminati specifici conformi ad attività di lavoro critiche. Gli esami di certificazione non sono consigliati agli utenti che non hanno esperienza diretta nell'utilizzo dei prodotti. Informazioni su questo esame L'esame di certificazione su Search Ads 360 copre i seguenti temi: creazione di campagne nella rete di ricerca con più motori di ricerca; assegnazione di obiettivi, targeting e strategie di offerta; risoluzione di problemi; misurazione dell'impatto e ottimizzazione delle campagne per migliorare il rendimento. Questo esame verifica le conoscenze su un'ampia gamma di argomenti relativi all'automazione, all'attribuzione, alla generazione dei rapporti e alla misurazione delle conversioni. Gli utenti che superano questo esame conoscono il settore della ricerca a pagamento e hanno capito come Search Ads 360 può essere sfruttato per gestire le campagne da un'unica interfaccia. Generalmente le conoscenze testate in questo esame sono conformi ai seguenti ruoli: Responsabile della ricerca a pagamento Amministratore della ricerca a pagamento Supervisore della ricerca a pagamento Analista della ricerca a pagamento

records.title: Egzamin certyfikacyjny z usługi Search Ads 360
records.description: Certyfikaty usług Google Marketing Platform są przyznawane użytkownikom, którzy potrafią zrealizować najważniejsze zadania i procesy w tych usługach. Egzaminy certyfikacyjne są przeznaczone dla użytkowników, którzy mają praktyczne doświadczenie w pracy z usługami Google Marketing Platform. Egzaminy sprawdzają określone umiejętności związane z wykonywaniem najważniejszych zadań. Użytkownikom, którzy nie mają bezpośredniego doświadczenia z tymi usługami, odradzamy przystępowanie do egzaminów certyfikacyjnych. Informacje o egzaminie Egzamin certyfikacyjny z zakresu Search Ads 360 obejmuje konfigurowanie kampanii w sieci wyszukiwania w wielu wyszukiwarkach, przypisywanie celów, ustawień kierowania reklam i strategii ustalania stawek, rozwiązywanie problemów, mierzenie wyników oraz optymalizowanie kampanii pod kątem poprawy skuteczności. Ten egzamin sprawdza wiedzę na wiele tematów związanych z automatyzacją, atrybucją, raportowaniem i mierzeniem konwersji. Do egzaminu powinni przystępować użytkownicy, którzy wiedzą, jak działają płatne wyniki wyszukiwania i jak można wykorzystać Search Ads 360 do zarządzania kampaniami za pomocą jednego interfejsu. Egzamin sprawdza wiedzę związaną zwykle z tymi rolami: Dyrektor ds. płatnych wyników wyszukiwania Menedżer ds. płatnych wyników wyszukiwania Kierownik ds. płatnych wyników wyszukiwania Analityk ds. płatnych wyników wyszukiwania Będziesz mieć 75 minut, aby odpowiedzieć na 50 pytań jednokrotnego wyboru.

Audience Profile This course is designed for developers who build backend and AI‑driven applications on Azure and need practical skills in containerized compute, data services for AI, event‑driven workflows, and application security and monitoring.

records.title: Procurement Under Grants: Exigency and Emergency Circumstances
records.description: This course equips FEMA grant recipients and subrecipients with the knowledge required to navigate federal procurement standards during periods of emergency or exigency (E&E), as outlined in 2 C.F.R. §§ 200.317-327. The course covers sole-sourcing under E&E, additional requirements for local governments and nonprofits, the use of pre-existing contracts, documentation and justification standards, contract provisions, and fraud prevention. Through practical examples and scenario-based learning, participants will gain a comprehensive understanding of the updated rules and risk areas associated with procurement under FEMA awards during E&E circumstances. Upon completion of this course, participants will be able to identify and implement federal procurement requirements specific to emergency and exigency periods, including proper sole-sourcing procedures, competitive procurement transitions, contract documentation, bonding and contract clause requirements, and fraud mitigation strategies. Participants will also be able to apply best practices for using prepositioned contracts and ensure compliance with federal regulations while protecting national interests and spending tax dollars responsibly.

AI 기반 쇼핑 광고 인증을 획득하면 Google로부터 다음과 같은 역량을 인정받게 됩니다. Google과 함께 소매 비즈니스 성장을 촉진하기 위한 기본사항을 설명합니다. 쇼핑 광고의 작동 방식을 설명합니다. 쇼핑 광고 생태계에서 정책의 중요성을 설명합니다. Google 쇼핑 정책의 핵심 구성요소를 파악합니다. 판매자 센터와 제품 피드가 쇼핑 전략을 어떻게 뒷받침하는지 설명합니다. 마케팅 목표에 적합한 캠페인 유형을 선택합니다. 소매업체를 위한 실적 최대화 캠페인이 더 많은 소비자들에게 도달하는 데 어떤 도움이 되는지 알아봅니다.

records.title: Examen de certificación de Display & Video 360
records.description: Las certificaciones de productos de Google Marketing Platform permiten a los usuarios demostrar su capacidad para realizar operaciones de flujos de trabajo y tareas esenciales con los productos de esta plataforma. Los exámenes de certificación están pensados para usuarios que tengan experiencia práctica con productos de Google Marketing Platform y los hayan usado en el mundo real. Para evaluarlos, se tienen en cuenta ciertos criterios relacionados con tareas esenciales. Estos exámenes no son recomendables para usuarios que no tengan experiencia directa con los productos. Información sobre este examen En el examen de certificación de Display & Video 360, se evalúan los conocimientos sobre la configuración de campañas programáticas y de acuerdos directos, lo que incluye la asignación de inventario, objetivos, presupuestos, criterios de segmentación y creatividades. El examen también permite evaluar la capacidad de realizar acciones de flujos de trabajo y tareas esenciales para solucionar problemas, medir el rendimiento y aplicar optimizaciones. Los conocimientos que se evalúan en este examen suelen estar relacionados con los siguientes puestos: Agentes comerciales de agencias Directores de publicidad en medios programáticos Dispondrás de 75 minutos para contestar a 50 preguntas de varias opciones.

records.description: Google 검색 캠페인의 구축 및 최적화에 대한 전문성을 입증합니다. 인증을 취득한 사용자는 스마트 자동 입찰 및 잠재고객 솔루션 등의 자동화된 솔루션을 활용해 캠페인 실적을 높여 특정 마케팅 목표를 달성하는 역량을 보여줍니다. Google Ads 검색 인증 취득 시 Google로부터 다음과 같은 역량을 인정받게 됩니다. 온라인 마케팅 비전을 일관된 디지털 마케팅 전략으로 전환합니다. 포괄적인 기업 마케팅 계획을 바탕으로 Google 검색 전략을 개발합니다. Google 검색을 사용해 리드, 판매 또는 웹 트래픽을 늘리는 계획을 세웁니다. Google 검색 잠재고객을 통해 신규 및 기존 고객에게 도달하는 계획을 세웁니다. 디지털 마케팅 예산에 부합하는 검색 마케팅 계획을 세웁니다. 참고: 일부 과정은 기본 언어로 제공되지 않거나 언어를 선택해야 하는 사이트 링크를 포함하고 있습니다.

records.title: Сертификационный экзамен по Дисплею и Видео 360
records.description: На сертификационных экзаменах по Google Платформе для маркетинга проверяется умение справляться с основными задачами в этом сервисе. Экзамены рассчитаны на пользователей с практическим опытом работы. Знания оцениваются на основе определенных критериев, связанных с решением ключевых рабочих задач. Мы не рекомендуем сдавать этот экзамен пользователям, которые ещё не работали с нашими сервисами. Об экзамене Сертификационный экзамен по Дисплею и Видео 360 включает вопросы по настройке кампаний с алгоритмическими продажами и прямыми сделками. Чтобы сдать его, вы должны уметь работать с инвентарем и креативами, разбираться в настройках таргетинга, а также назначать бюджет и отслеживать целевые показатели. Кроме того, на экзамене проверяется способность справляться со сложными задачами и процессами, такими как устранение неполадок, оценка эффективности и оптимизация. Знаниями, которые проверяются в ходе экзамена, обычно обладают представители следующих специальностей: специалисты по продажам из агентств; специалисты по медийной рекламе с алгоритмической продажей. Экзамен длится 75 минут и состоит из 50 вопросов с несколькими вариантами ответа.

records.prerequisites: for this course. The 401V course is identical in content to the 401L. The 401 course is offered in both in-person and online formats. This instructor-led, three-day course provides hands-on training on how to analyze, evaluate, and document the cybersecurity posture of an organization’s industrial control systems (ICS) to identify recommended changes. Specifically, this course will utilize the Cyber Security Evaluation Tool (CSET ® ), along with a simulated ICS scenario that teaches how to analyze cybersecurity weaknesses and threats, evaluate issues, document potential mitigations, and provide ongoing resolutions to strengthen the organization’s cybersecurity posture. This course will also increase awareness of how a threat related to the ICS translates into a threat to business operations. Attendees will learn how most businesses have numerous support processes and systems controlled by, or otherwise dependent on, an ICS. After completion of this course, attendees will have the basic skills necessary to conduct a self-evaluation of their organization’s ICS and deliver their recommendations to an upper-management audience. Attendees will have a tool (CSET ® ) to evaluate cybersecurity posture at their workplace. After attending this course, participants will be able to: Discuss components of an ICS evaluation. Identify assets within ICS networks. Determine ICS connectivity. Evaluate network monitoring capabilities. Discuss the use of wireless in ICS environments. Evaluate risk using open source intelligence and operations security methods. Evaluate risk from adversaries. Determine ICS dependencies. Assess supply risk. Evaluate risk management and mitigation approaches. Prerequisites Participants should have a basic understanding of cybersecurity in an ICS environment. Suggested prerequisite courses for the 401 courses are: 100W Cybersecurity Practices for Industrial Control Systems 210W-03 Common ICS Components 210W-05 ICS Cybersecurity Risk or ICS Cybersecurity Landscape for Managers

records.title: Exame de certificação do Campaign Manager 360
records.description: As certificações de produto da Google Marketing Platform identificam os utilizadores qualificados que demonstraram a capacidade de executar tarefas e fluxos de trabalho críticos com os produtos da plataforma. Os exames de certificação foram concebidos para utilizadores com experiência prática e real nos produtos da Google Marketing Platform, além disso, avaliam critérios específicos predeterminados associados à realização de tarefas críticas. Os exames de certificação não são recomendados para utilizadores que não têm experiência direta no produto. Acerca deste exame O exame de certificação do Campaign Manager abrange o planeamento, a implementação, a criação de relatórios e a resolução de problemas no âmbito das compras por reserva durante o trabalho com vários parceiros. Também avalia o fornecimento de etiquetas de anúncios, a medição e os métodos de resolução de problemas usados para otimizar o desempenho. Os utilizadores que concluam este exame devem ter experiência no Campaign Manager. O exame cobre uma utilização ampla do produto, desde o tráfego até aos relatórios. As funções especializadas (como gestores de agências) podem não estar devidamente alinhadas com os vastos conhecimentos que este exame avalia. Normalmente, os conhecimentos avaliados neste exame estão alinhados com as seguintes funções: Gestor de tráfego de anúncios Analista Tem 75 minutos para responder a 50 perguntas de escolha múltipla.

records.title: 21st Century Learning Design
records.description: Learners around the world need advanced skills to succeed in the today's globalized, knowledge-based world. 21st Century Learning Design, or 21CLD, professional development helps educators redesign their existing lessons and learning activities to build learners' 21st century skills. Transforming education by focusing on 21st century skills is one of Microsoft's focus areas, and providing workshops for educators on the 21CLD curriculum has been successful. The 21CLD curriculum - developed to enhance 21st century skills in student learning - builds on the 21CLD research methodology, providing a collaborative, practice-based process that helps educators transform how they design enriching learning activities for their learners. The eight courses incorporate online tutorials, video, readings, educator-discussion, and self-assessment. Educators have the opportunity to actively engage with evidence of 21CLD in action in classes across the globe. The 21CLD curriculum is based on rubrics, which were developed and tested internationally for the Innovative Teaching and Learning (ITL) Research project. These rubrics help educators identify and understand the opportunities that learning activities give learners to build 21st century skills. A learning activity is any task that learners do as part of their school-related work. It can be an exercise that learners complete in one class period or an extended project that takes place both in and outside of school. The 21CLD rubrics incorporate a research-based methodology for coding learning activities to ensure you're embedding 21st century skills in your teaching practices. records.description: Pokaż, że potrafisz mierzyć i optymalizować skuteczność reklam internetowych, stosując rozwiązania pomiarowe Google. records.title: Manage business solutions with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central
records.description: Built and optimized for small and medium businesses, Dynamics 365 Business Central is an application for companies that have outgrown their entry-level business applications. Growing businesses often outgrow their basic accounting software or legacy enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems that are unable to handle increased inventory and transactions, lack integration with other line-of-business systems, and have reporting limitations. Businesses are also challenged with the logistics of providing services that have more scalability, increased mobility, and availability in the cloud. With Business Central, you can manage your financials, automate and secure your supply chain, sell smarter, improve customer service and project performance, and optimize your operations. Audience Profile Candidates for this course are functional consultants who implement core application setup processes for small and medium businesses. They implement and configure Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central including setting up core functionality and modules and migrating data to Business Central. Candidates configure the application in collaboration with the implementation team to provide the business with manageability and ease of use. They may configure role centers including adapting insights, cues, action tiles, reports, charts, and extend Business Central by using Power Platform components. Candidates have applied knowledge of meeting business needs by using Business Central, including basic understanding of financial management, sales, purchasing, and inventory. Candidates for this exam typically specialize in one or more feature sets of Business Central. They understand the role of Business Central in relationship to the Microsoft 365 and Dynamics 365 suites of applications.

records.description: Penyunting Peta Waze – Penutupan Jalan dan Acara Trafik Oleh Cristina Carbonel Diterbitkan Sep 2, 2025 Pengadaran 1 bintang 2 bintang 3 bintang 4 bintang 5 bintang Pengadaran purata: 0 0 Tiada ulasan Mulakan Selamat datang ke Kursus Acara Trafik dan Penutupan Jalan Penyunting Peta Waze! Sebagai Penyunting Peta Waze, anda memainkan peranan penting dalam memastikan peta sentiasa tepat dan membantu pemandu mengemudi dengan lancar. records.title: Planning and Deploying SAP on Azure
records.description: This course teaches IT Professionals experienced in SAP solutions how to leverage Azure resources that include deployment and configuration of virtual machines, virtual networks, storage accounts, and Azure AD that includes implementing and managing hybrid identities. Students of this course will learn through concepts, scenarios, procedures, and hands-on labs how to best plan and implement migration and operation of an SAP solution on Azure. Your will receive guidance on subscriptions, create and scale virtual machines, implement storage solutions, configure virtual networking, back up and share data, connect Azure and on-premises sites, manage network traffic, implement Azure Active Directory, secure identities, and monitor your solution. Audience Profile This course is for Azure Administrators who migrate and manage SAP solutions on Azure. Azure Administrators manage the cloud services that span storage, networking, and compute cloud capabilities, with a deep understanding of each service across the full IT lifecycle. They take end-user requests for new cloud applications and make recommendations on services to use for optimal performance and scale, as well as provision, size, monitor and adjust as appropriate. This role requires communicating and coordinating with vendors. Azure Administrators use the Azure Portal and as they become more proficient they use PowerShell and the Command Line Interface.

records.title: Implement analytics solutions using Microsoft Fabric
records.description: This course covers how to prepare, enrich, and serve data for analysis by consumers such as data analysts, report developers, and AI agents. The course focuses on designing dimensional models and transforming data by using dataflows, notebooks, and T-SQL across lakehouses, warehouses, and eventhouses in Microsoft Fabric. The course also covers building and optimizing semantic models, managing the analytics development lifecycle, and enforcing security and governance across data assets. Audience Profile This course is intended for data professionals with experience in data modeling, transformation, and analytics. Learners should have prior experience translating business requirements into analytical measures by using Structured Query Language (SQL) or Data Analysis Expressions (DAX). Experience building semantic models and reports in Power BI is recommended. Familiarity with Kusto Query Language (KQL) and Python is also helpful but not required.

records.title: Waze Map Editor - Road Closures and Traffic Events
records.description: Welcome to the Waze Map Editor Traffic Events and Road Closures Course! As a Waze Map Editor, you play a vital role in keeping the map accurate and helping drivers navigate smoothly. But road closures can still disrupt their journeys. By mapping Traffic Events and road closures, you help Waze provide advanced and real-time updates and smarter routes. Traffic Events explain why an area is affected, like concerts, construction, or emergencies, while Road Closures define the specific segments that are closed. Together, they can be used in three ways: as closures tied to Traffic Events, as polygons that trigger driver notifications, or as a combination of both. In this course, you’ll learn: How to add and manage Traffic Events and Road Closures in WME How Traffic Events and Road Closures affect Waze drivers' routes and notifications Click on each link to complete a learning path, then complete the assessment and the survey. records.title: Examen de certificación de Campaign Manager 360
records.description: Las certificaciones de productos de Google Marketing Platform permiten identificar a los usuarios calificados que demostraron su habilidad para realizar tareas y flujos de trabajo fundamentales con los productos de GMP. Los exámenes de certificación se diseñaron para los usuarios con experiencia real y práctica en el uso de los productos de Google Marketing Platform y en ellos se evalúan criterios predeterminados específicos en consonancia con la realización de tareas importantes. No se recomiendan estos exámenes para los usuarios que no tienen experiencia directa con los productos. Acerca de este examen El examen de certificación de Campaign Manager 360 abarca la planificación, la implementación, la creación de informes y la solución de problemas de compras por reservación mientras se trabaja con diferentes socios. También se evalúan la publicación de etiquetas de anuncios, las mediciones y los métodos de solución de problemas que se utilizan para optimizar el rendimiento. Los usuarios que completen este examen deben ser usuarios experimentados de Campaign Manager. La evaluación abarca el uso amplio de productos, desde la coordinación de anuncios hasta la generación de informes. Es posible que el conocimiento que forma parte de funciones especializadas (como el de los planificadores de agencias) no se corresponda con el que se evalúa en este examen. El conocimiento que se evalúa en este examen corresponde a los siguientes roles: Coordinador de anuncios Analista Tendrás 75 minutos para responder 50 preguntas de opción múltiple.

records.title: Chứng chỉ Campaign Manager 360 (2026)
records.description: Các chứng chỉ về sản phẩm liên quan đến Google Marketing Platform xác định những người dùng đủ tiêu chuẩn, có khả năng thực hiện những công việc và quy trình cực kỳ quan trọng khi sử dụng các sản phẩm của Google Marketing Platform. Bài thi cấp chứng chỉ được thiết kế nhằm mang đến cho người dùng trải nghiệm thực tế khi sử dụng các sản phẩm của Google Marketing Platform. Bài thi này cũng kiểm tra xem người dùng có đáp ứng các tiêu chí cụ thể được xác định trước để thực hiện các công việc cực kỳ quan trọng hay không. Người dùng chưa trải nghiệm trực tiếp sản phẩm không nên làm các bài thi cấp chứng chỉ này. Thông tin về bài thi này Chứng chỉ Campaign Manager 360 đánh giá khả năng lập kế hoạch, thực thi và tối ưu hoá các chiến dịch kỹ thuật số phức tạp. Bài thi này bao gồm nội dung về hệ phân cấp kỹ thuật của cấu trúc Tài khoản và Vị trí, việc triển khai tính năng theo dõi của bên thứ nhất thông qua Thẻ Google và việc thực thi các quy trình công việc nâng cao về Video (VAST/VPAID). Ngoài quy trình thiết lập và chạy quảng cáo cơ bản, người dùng còn được kiểm tra khả năng khắc phục mâu thuẫn về cách phân phối, tích hợp với Display & Video 360 và khai thác Trình quản lý dữ liệu để nhập lượt chuyển đổi ngoại tuyến. Các vai trò phù hợp với ứng viên: --Nhà quản lý và điều hành quảng cáo --Nhà phân tích --Chuyên viên kế hoạch truyền thông Bạn sẽ có 75 phút để hoàn thành 50 câu hỏi trắc nghiệm.

records.title: Synergizing Disaster Risk Reduction and Climate Action Learning Path
records.description: *NEW AND EXPANDED VERSION* This updated and expanded learning path, developed in partnership with the UN Office for Disaster Risk Reduction (UNDRR), builds on the success of the original course and responds to the growing demand for practical guidance on integrating disaster risk reduction (DRR) and climate action. The learning path is organized into two complementary modules. The first module introduces the fundamental concepts, frameworks, and approaches for promoting coherence between DRR and climate change adaptation through Comprehensive Risk Management (CRM). The second module provides a deeper exploration of real-world applications, showcasing case studies and good practices from different regions and governance levels where DRR and climate action have been successfully integrated. Through this combination of foundational knowledge and practical examples, participants will gain a comprehensive understanding of how synergizing DRR and climate action can strengthen resilience, optimize resources, and support coherent risk management strategies. Spanish and French versions will be available soon!

records.title: Administer Microsoft 365 and AI services
records.description: Important **This course will be available on 10/30/2026. In this course, you learn to configure, manage, secure, govern, and optimize Microsoft 365 tenants, workloads, Microsoft 365 Copilot, agents, and Microsoft Agent 365. Through instructor-led discussions, demonstrations, scenarios, and hands-on labs, you practice tenant provisioning, licensing, workload configuration, identity and access management, threat protection, information protection, and data governance. You assess Copilot readiness, configure Copilot settings and extensibility, establish agent identities with Microsoft Entra Agent ID, and curate agents and tools through the Agent Registry. You also use Microsoft Agent 365 to monitor agent activity, manage permissions and policies, investigate risks, govern agent lifecycles, and evaluate adoption and effectiveness. By the end of the course, you can administer Microsoft 365 and AI services at enterprise scale while supporting secure collaboration, compliance, operational resilience, and responsible agent adoption. Audience Profile As a Microsoft 365 and AI Services Administrator, you configure, manage, secure, and govern Microsoft 365 tenants, workloads, and AI services, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, agents, and connected AI capabilities. You enable secure, compliant, and scalable productivity across the organization by governing data access, protecting information, and supporting collaboration between users and agents. You operate and continuously optimize Microsoft 365 and AI services at enterprise-scale, ensuring reliable and effective outcomes in an AI-powered workplace. You collaborate with architects and administrators across workloads, infrastructure, identity, security, compliance, endpoints, and applications. You should have experience with Microsoft 365 workloads and Microsoft Entra ID, an understanding of Microsoft Defender XDR capabilities, and familiarity with Microsoft Graph PowerShell. As a Microsoft 365 administrator, you: Configure and manage Microsoft 365 tenants and workloads Secure and govern Microsoft 365 tenants and workloads Manage and secure Microsoft 365 AI services

records.title: Certification Campaign Manager 360 (2026)
records.description: Les certifications produit Google Marketing Platform identifient les utilisateurs qualifiés ayant la capacité d'exécuter des tâches et des workflows critiques avec les produits Platform. Les examens de certification s'adressent aux utilisateurs possédant une expérience pratique et concrète des produits Google Marketing Platform. Ils incluent des tests basés sur des critères prédéfinis précis en lien avec des tâches professionnelles critiques. Ils ne sont pas conseillés aux personnes qui n'utilisent pas directement les produits. À propos de cet examen La certification Campaign Manager 360 évalue la capacité à planifier, exécuter et optimiser des campagnes numériques sophistiquées. L'examen porte sur la hiérarchie technique des structures de compte et d'emplacement, le déploiement du suivi first party avec la balise Google et l'exécution de workflows vidéo avancés (VAST/VPAID). Au-delà du trafficking de base, les utilisateurs sont testés sur leur capacité à résoudre les conflits de diffusion, à intégrer Display & Video 360 et à exploiter le Gestionnaire de données pour l'ingestion des conversions hors ligne. Profils des candidats idéaux : -- Traffickers et spécialistes des opérations publicitaires -- Analystes -- Média-planners Vous disposerez de 75 minutes pour répondre à 50 questions à choix multiples.

records.title: Zertifizierungsprüfung zu Campaign Manager 360
records.description: In den Zertifizierungsprüfungen für die Google Marketing Platform können Nutzer ihr Wissen über die Aufgaben und Workflows in Platform-Produkten unter Beweis stellen. Die Prüfungen sind für Nutzer gedacht, die praktische Erfahrungen mit Platform-Produkten haben. Es wird getestet, ob sie bei wichtigen Aufgaben bestimmte Kriterien erfüllen. Die Zertifizierungsprüfungen werden nicht für Nutzer empfohlen, die keine direkte Produkterfahrung haben. Informationen zu dieser Prüfung In der Zertifizierungsprüfung zu Campaign Manager geht es um die Planung, Implementierung, Berichterstellung und Fehlerbehebung in Verbindung mit Reservierungskäufen. Außerdem wird geprüft, ob Sie die Methoden zur Auslieferung von Anzeigen-Tags sowie zur Messung und zur Behebung von Fehlern beherrschen, mit denen die Leistung optimiert wird. Nutzer, die diese Prüfung ablegen, sollten Erfahrung mit Campaign Manager haben. In dieser Prüfung geht es um die allgemeine Verwendung des Produkts, vom Trafficking bis zur Berichterstellung. Für spezialisierte Tätigkeitsbereiche wie den eines Agency Planner sind die in dieser Prüfung getesteten Kenntnisse möglicherweise zu allgemein. Die in dieser Prüfung getesteten Kenntnisse sind für folgende Positionen relevant: Trafficker Analyst Sie haben 75 Minuten Zeit, um 50 Multiple-Choice-Fragen zu beantworten.

records.title: Сертификационный экзамен по Менеджеру кампаний 360 (2026 г.)
records.description: На сертификационных экзаменах по Google Платформе для маркетинга проверяется умение справляться с основными задачами в этом сервисе. Экзамены рассчитаны на пользователей с практическим опытом работы. Знания оцениваются на основе определенных критериев, связанных с решением ключевых рабочих задач. Пользователям без опыта работы с продуктами сдавать экзамены не рекомендуется. Об экзамене Сертификационный экзамен по Менеджеру кампаний 360 предназначен для оценки умения планировать, проводить и оптимизировать сложные цифровые кампании. Он охватывает техническую иерархию структур аккаунтов и мест размещения, развертывание собственного отслеживания с помощью тега Google и выполнение расширенных рабочих процессов с видео (шаблон VAST/VPAID). Помимо базовых навыков размещения рекламы, кандидаты должны продемонстрировать умение устранять конфликты при показе, интегрировать Менеджер кампаний 360 с Дисплеем и Видео 360, а также использовать Менеджер данных для передачи офлайн-конверсий. Экзамен в основном предназначен для представителей следующих специальностей: --трафик-менеджеры и менеджеры по рекламе; --аналитики; --менеджеры по медиапланированию. Экзамен длится 75 минут и состоит из 50 вопросов с несколькими вариантами ответа.

Audience Profile This course is targeted to security professionals interested in getting started with Microsoft Security Copilot, including security analysts, security admins, and SOC managers. records.title: Exame de certificação do Search Ads 360
records.description: Os exames de certificação no Google Marketing Platform identificam usuários qualificados que conseguiram desempenhar tarefas críticas e fluxos de trabalho nos produtos do Platform. Os exames de certificação são feitos para usuários que têm experiência prática com os produtos do Google Marketing Platform. Eles se baseiam em critérios específicos predeterminados, associados a tarefas críticas. Os exames não são recomendados para usuários que não têm experiência direta com o produto. Sobre o exame O exame de certificação no Search Ads 360 aborda vários assuntos: configuração de campanhas da rede de pesquisa em vários mecanismos de pesquisa, atribuição de metas, segmentação e estratégias de lances, solução de problemas, avaliação do impacto e otimização das campanhas para melhor desempenho. O exame testa conhecimentos relacionados a vários assuntos, como automação, atribuição, geração de relatórios e medição de conversão. Os usuários que quiserem prestar o exame deverão ter uma boa compreensão do setor de pesquisa paga e de como o Search Ads 360 pode ser utilizado para gerenciar campanhas a partir de uma interface. records.title: Zertifizierungsprüfung „Conversion-Optimierung“
records.description: In den Zertifizierungsprüfungen für die Google Marketing Platform können Nutzer ihr Wissen über die Aufgaben und Workflows in Platform-Produkten unter Beweis stellen. Diese Zertifizierungsprüfung ist für Nutzer mit praktischer Erfahrung gedacht. Es wird getestet, ob sie bei wichtigen Aufgaben bestimmte Kriterien erfüllen. Zweck dieser Prüfung Zeigen Sie Ihren Kunden, dass Sie das notwendige Fachwissen haben, um höhere Umsätze durch mehr Nutzerfreundlichkeit auf Mobilgeräten zu erzielen. records.title: Examen de certificación de Search Ads 360
records.description: Las certificaciones de productos de Google Marketing Platform identifican a los usuarios calificados que muestran capacidad para realizar tareas fundamentales y flujos de trabajo con los productos de dicha plataforma. Los exámenes de certificación están diseñados para los usuarios con experiencia real y práctica en el uso de productos de Google Marketing Platform y evalúan criterios predeterminados específicos en consonancia con la realización de tareas importantes. No recomendamos los exámenes de certificación para los usuarios que no posean experiencia directa en relación con los productos. Acerca de este examen El examen de certificación de Search Ads 360 abarca la configuración de campañas de Búsqueda en diversos motores de búsqueda; el establecimiento de objetivos, orientaciones y estrategias de oferta; la solución de problemas; la medición del impacto; y la optimización de las campañas para mejorar el rendimiento. Este examen evalúa el conocimiento en una amplia gama de temas relacionados con automatización, atribución, informes y medición de conversiones. Los usuarios que completen este examen deberán comprender el funcionamiento de la industria de la búsqueda de pago y cómo aprovechar Search Ads 360 para administrar las campañas desde una única interfaz. El conocimiento que se evalúa en este examen suele corresponder a las siguientes funciones: Director de búsqueda de pago Administrador de búsqueda de pago Supervisor de búsqueda de pago Analista de búsqueda de pago Tendrás 75 minutos para responder 50 preguntas de opción múltiple.

records.title: Egzamin certyfikacyjny z optymalizacji konwersji
records.description: Certyfikaty w zakresie usług Google Marketing Platform potwierdzają kwalifikacje użytkowników, którzy wykazali się umiejętnością realizacji najważniejszych zadań i procesów w tych usługach. Ten egzamin certyfikacyjny jest przeznaczony dla użytkowników z doświadczeniem praktycznym i sprawdza umiejętności według kryteriów związanych z kluczowymi zadaniami. Informacje o egzaminie Udowodnij, że potrafisz zwiększać przychody firmy poprzez optymalizację wygody użytkowników komórek. Ten egzamin sprawdza wiedzę z szerokiego zakresu tematów związanych z wygodą i wygodą użytkowników komórek. Użytkownicy przystępujący do tego egzaminu powinni posiadać wiedzę na temat komórek jako kanału pozyskiwania klientów oraz rozumieć jego rolę w zachowaniach online. Przyznając Ci certyfikat Google Ads z rozwijania firmy dzięki zwiększaniu wygody użytkownika na urządzeniach mobilnych, firma Google potwierdza, że potrafisz: oceniać znaczenie wygody użytkownika po kliknięciu reklamy; współpracować z kluczowymi partnerami w tworzeniu organizacji bardziej zorientowanej na użytkownika; opisywać podstawowe elementy i zalety optymalizacji współczynnika konwersji (CRO); wyjaśniać rolę marketerów w zapewnianiu szybkiej obsługi użytkownikom komórek; wyjaśniać rolę marketerów w zapewnianiu wygody użytkowników; wdrażać sprawdzone metody pozwalające zwiększać stopień personalizacji, jeśli chodzi o obsługę użytkowników komórek. Uwaga: niektóre kursy zawierają linki do stron niedostępnych w wybranym przez Ciebie języku lub do stron, na których trzeba wybrać język.

records.description: Accurately reflecting real-life traffic restrictions in the Waze Map Editor is essential for improving driver experiences and ensuring smoother commutes. In this training, you'll learn how to add real-life restrictions directly to the map, making an impact by guiding drivers through safer, more efficient routes. You'll discover how to apply restrictions based on timing, vehicle types, passenger counts, registration plate numbers, and more, as well as manage specialized lanes like Bus, Express, Fast, HOT, or HOV. Plus, you'll explore how to combine multiple restrictions to handle complex traffic scenarios. Once you've completed the training, you'll take an assessment to demonstrate your knowledge. Pass the assessment, and you'll earn a badge to showcase your expertise. Let's dive in and help drivers get where they need to go! records.title: Certificeringsexamen voor Campaign Manager 360
records.description: Met de productcertificeringen van Google Marketing Platform kunnen gekwalificeerde gebruikers aantonen dat ze in staat zijn om essentiële taken en workflows uit te voeren met Platform-producten. De certificeringen zijn bedoeld voor gebruikers die al praktijkervaring hebben met Google Marketing Platform-producten. In de examens wordt getest op bepaalde vooraf vastgestelde criteria die aansluiten bij essentiële taken. De certificeringsexamens worden niet aangeraden voor gebruikers die geen directe productervaring hebben. Over dit examen In het certificeringsexamen voor Campaign Manager behandelen we het volgende: planning, implementatie, rapportage en problemen oplossen bij Kopen op basis van reservering (terwijl u met verschillende partners werkt). We testen ook uw kennis over de weergave van advertentietags, metingen en methoden voor probleemoplossing waarmee prestaties kunnen worden geoptimaliseerd. Gebruikers die dit examen afleggen, moeten ervaren gebruikers van Campaign Manager zijn. In dit examen worden vele manieren van productgebruik behandeld, van trafficking tot rapportage. De brede kennis die in dit examen wordt getest, is mogelijk niet altijd relevant voor gespecialiseerde rollen (zoals planners van een bureau). De kennis die we in dit examen testen, is relevant voor de volgende rollen: Trafficker Analist U heeft 75 minuten om 50 meerkeuzevragen te beantwoorden.

records.description: Google Marketing Platform Ürün Sertifikaları, Platform ürünlerini kullanarak kritik görevleri ve iş akışlarını yürütebilen nitelikli kullanıcıları belirlemeyi amaçlar. Sertifika sınavları, Google Marketing Platform ürünlerini kullanma konusunda uygulamalı deneyimi bulunan kullanıcılar için tasarlanmıştır. Bu sınavlarda, işle ilgili kritik görevler doğrultusunda önceden belirlenmiş belirli ölçütler test edilir. Bu sınav hakkında Campaign Manager 360 sertifika sınavı, iş ortaklarıyla ilgili rezervasyonla satın alma işlemlerinde planlama, uygulama, raporlama ve sorun giderme konularını kapsar. Bu sınava yalnızca Campaign Manager 360 konusunda deneyimli olan kullanıcılar girmelidir. Bu sınav, trafik işlemlerinden raporlamaya uzanan geniş bir ürün kullanım alanını kapsar. Özel pozisyonlar (ajans planlayıcısı gibi), bu sınavda test edilen geniş kapsamlı bilgiler için uygun olmayabilir.
